tags.name: BlankTag
tags.description: Can be used to leave space in a collection. To leave a collection item blank, specify it as a scalar of less than 8 bytes (such as a UINT4), and specify it as embedded.

tags.name: ContainerTag
tags.description: Record-level tag which identifies the container record (always the first one in the file, and there must be only one per file).

tags.name: DataSourceTag
tags.description: Record-level tag which identifies a data source (an instrument, etc.).

tags.name: MonitorSettingsTag
tags.description: Record-level tag which identifies a set of configuration parameters.

tags.name: ObservationTag
tags.description: Record-level tag which identifies an observation -- an event, measurement, etc.

tags.name: VersionInfoTag
tags.description: Specifies the format version for read/write compatibility. The four required numbers in the vector are described below.

tags.name: FileNameTag
tags.description: Original name of the file.

tags.name: CreationTag
tags.description: Date/time when the file was created.

tags.name: LastSavedTag
tags.description: Date/time when the file was last saved.

tags.name: TimesSavedTag
tags.description: The number of times the file has been saved/modified.

tags.name: LanguageTag
tags.description: The language (English, etc.) of the file.

tags.name: TitleTag
tags.description: Arbitrary title.

tags.name: SubjectTag
tags.description: Arbitrary subject string

tags.name: AuthorTag
tags.description: Individual/company who caused the file to be written

tags.name: KeywordsTag
tags.description: Keywords for assisting searches

tags.name: CommentsTag
tags.description: Arbitrary comments

tags.name: LastSavedByTag
tags.description: Individual/company who last wrote to file

tags.name: ApplicationTag
tags.description: Creating application

tags.name: SecurityTag
tags.description: Security descriptor information

tags.name: OwnerTag
tags.description: Owner of file contents (This and some of the following fields are for copyright and trademark information)

tags.name: CopyrightTag
tags.description: Copyright notice

tags.name: TrademarksTag
tags.description: Trademark notice

tags.name: NotesTag
tags.description: RTF formatted notes associated with this file (This corresponds to the IEEE COMTRADE .HDR file, for example).

tags.name: CompressionStyleTag
tags.description: Specified how the compression is applied to the file.

tags.name: CompressionAlgorithmTag
tags.description: Required if tagCompressionStyleID specifies that compression is turned on.

tags.name: CompressionChecksumTag
tags.description: If compression style is _TOTALFILE, this is the checksum for the entire file. This feature has been deprecated under 1.5.

tags.name: VendorIDTag
tags.description: Since this ID is a Guid, you can generate a custom ID if a standard ID is not defined.

tags.name: EquipmentIDTag
tags.description: Since this ID is a Guid, you can generate a custom ID if a standard ID is not defined.

tags.name: CustomSourceInfoTag
tags.description: This collection can include the standard name, address & telephone number tags -- these apply to the vendor -- as well as tags about the instrument itself.

tags.name: SerialNumberTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string to hold data souce (instrument) serial number

tags.name: DataSourceVersionTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string to hold data souce (instrument) version number (if applicable)

tags.name: DataSourceNameTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string to hold the name of the data souce (instrument)

tags.name: DataSourceOwnerTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string to hold data souce (instrument) owner name

tags.name: DataSourceLocationTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string to hold data souce (instrument) location information

tags.name: DataSourceTimeZoneTag
tags.description: EST, CST, etc.

tags.name: DataSourceCoordinatesTag
tags.description: Longitude/latitude

tags.name: ChannelDefinitionsTag
tags.description: The tagChannelDefns collection must be a collection where the count = the number of channel definitions. Each entry must be another collection, each having the tagOneChannelDefn tag.

tags.name: InstrumentModelNameTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string

tags.name: InstrumentModelNumberTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string

tags.name: OneChannelDefinitionTag
tags.description: Must have one or more channel definitions

tags.name: ChannelNameTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string

tags.name: PhaseIDTag
tags.description: Phase identifier

tags.name: OtherChannelIdentifierTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string

tags.name: GroupNameTag
tags.description: This tag can be repeated if there are multiple groupings. The first one should be the highest-level group (example: a bus), and the next one should be a lower group (example: a feeder).

tags.name: QuantityTypeIDTag
tags.description: The high-level description of the type of quantity which is being captured by this channel. In order to guarantee reader compatibility, the following series value types (in order) should be used (ID_SERIES_VALUE_TYPE_VAL, etc.).

tags.name: QuantityMeasuredIDTag
tags.description: Identifies the physical quantity under measurement -- Voltage, Current, Power, etc. In general, there is a one-to-one correspondence between this and the units of the series, but not always.

tags.name: PhysicalChannelTag
tags.description: The instrument physical channel that this channel definition is associated with.

tags.name: QuantityNameTag
tags.description: Additional quantity information.

tags.name: PrimarySeriesIndexTag
tags.description: Identifies the series which will be the primary. Index into the tagSeriesDefns collection.

tags.name: SeriesDefinitionsTag
tags.description: The tagSeriesDefns collection must be a collection where the count = the number of series definitions. Each entry must be another collection, each having the tagOneSeriesDefn tag.

tags.name: OneSeriesDefinitionTag
tags.description: One of these collections per series.

tags.name: ValueTypeIDTag
tags.description: This specifies the meaning of the series data.

tags.name: QuantityUnitsIDTag
tags.description: This specifies the units of the data in this series. The expected physical type for the tagSeriesValues vector is REAL4 or Real8 (except as noted).

tags.name: QuantityCharacteristicIDTag
tags.description: This specifies additional detail about the meaning of the series data.

tags.name: QuantitySignificantDigitsIDTag
tags.description: Defines the number of significant digits in the data represented by this series.

tags.name: QuantityResolutionIDTag
tags.description: Contains a double indicating the scaled distance between two values of the quantity represented by this series (e.g. scaled A/D resolution)

tags.name: StorageMethodIDTag
tags.description: The legal values for this entry are masks, since they are OR-able.

tags.name: ValueTypeNameTag
tags.description: Arbitrary string

tags.name: ProbabilityIntervalTag
tags.description: For a probability series definition, this specifies its time interval (in seconds; >0).

tags.name: ProbabilityPercentileTag
tags.description: For a probability series definition, this specifies its probability percentile (in percent; 0-100).

tags.name: SeriesNominalQuantityTag
tags.description: Contains the default nominal base voltage or any or any other necessary normalizing quantity. Display programs may use this value or the tagSeriesBaseQuantity in the series instance for displaying data in percent or per unit.

tags.name: EffectiveTag
tags.description: The time that these settings become effective.

tags.name: UseCalibrationTag
tags.description: If TRUE, the calibration adjustments *must* be applied to the series data before using. Otherwise the data is for informative use only.

tags.name: UseTransducerTag
tags.description: If TRUE, the transducer adjustments *must* be applied to the series data before using. Otherwise the data is for informative use only.

tags.name: ChannelSettingsArrayTag
tags.description: Channel specific monitor settings stuff

tags.name: NominalFrequencyTag
tags.description: Nominal power system frequency for this instrument in Hertz

tags.name: SettingPhysicalConnectionTag
tags.description: Identifies the physical connection of the instrumentation or insturment transducers.

tags.name: OneChannelSettingTag
tags.description: One of these collections per channel.

tags.name: ChannelDefinitionIndexTag
tags.description: The channel definition which these settings apply to. Index into tagChannelDefns collection of the matching data source record.

tags.name: TriggerTypeIDTag
tags.description: Integer ID representing which trigger fields are used.

tags.name: FullScaleTag
tags.description: Full scale range for this instrument channel

tags.name: NoiseFloorTag
tags.description: Noise floor for this instrument channel

tags.name: TriggerShapeParametersTag
tags.description: Parameters for shape based triggering algorithms for this channel

tags.name: XDTransformerTypeIDTag
tags.description: PT or CT

tags.name: XDSystemSideRatioTag
tags.description: System side part of ratio

tags.name: XDMonitorSideRatioTag
tags.description: Monitor side part of ratio

tags.name: XDFrequencyResponseTag
tags.description: Transducer frequency response

tags.name: CalTimeSkewTag
tags.description: Chanel time skew

tags.name: CalOffsetTag
tags.description: Channel DC offset error

tags.name: CalRatioTag
tags.description: Channel ratio error

tags.name: CalMustUseARCalTag
tags.description: Flag indicating that the applied/recordedt calibration arrays must be used to correct data.

tags.name: CalAppliedTag
tags.description: Array of applied signals for this channel

tags.name: CalRecordedTag
tags.description: Array of recorded actual values for the applied signal

tags.name: TriggerHighHighTag
tags.description: High High trigger for this channel

tags.name: TriggerHighTag
tags.description: High trigger for this channel

tags.name: TriggerLowTag
tags.description: Low trigger for this channel

tags.name: TriggerLowLowTag
tags.description: Low Low trigger for this channel

tags.name: TriggerDeadbandTag
tags.description: Deadband trigger for this channel

tags.name: TriggerRateTag
tags.description: Rate of change trigger for this channel

tags.name: ObservationNameTag
tags.description: Name of the observation

tags.name: TimeCreateTag
tags.description: Time this observation was created

tags.name: TimeStartTag
tags.description: The start time of the observation -- the zero point where the .

tags.name: TriggerMethodTag
tags.description: Type of trigger which caused the observation.

tags.name: TimeTriggeredTag
tags.description: Tme this observation was triggered if appropriate

tags.name: ChannelTriggerIndexTag
tags.description: Index into tagChannelInstances collection within this record. This specifies which channel(s) initiated the observation.

tags.name: ObservationSerialTag
tags.description: The serial number of the observation (if generated by an instrument, for example).

tags.name: ObservationAggregationSerialTag
tags.description: Serial number -- of specific cycle, for example -- that can be used to correlate observations.

tags.name: DisturbanceCategoryIDTag
tags.description: Currently uses the IEEE 1159 disturbance categories, but others could be used as well.

tags.name: ChannelInstancesTag
tags.description: This collection contains a set of channel instances. It is not required to contain the same number of channels as there are channel instances. This can be determined on an observation-by-observation basis.

tags.name: CharacterizationDisturbanceDirectionTag
tags.description: Direction of disturbance represented by the data in this observation. Value of 0 means don't know, 1 means originated from load side, 2 means originated from source side.

tags.name: CharacterizationDisturbanceDirectionQualityTag
tags.description: Quality of the direction result given in another tag. Range is from 0 (no confidence), to 100 (darn sure).

tags.name: OneChannelInstanceTag
tags.description: One of these collections per channel instance.

tags.name: CharacterizationDurationTag
tags.description: Simple characterization value: duration of disturbance (seconds)

tags.name: SeriesInstancesTag
tags.description: This collection must contain the exact number of series which were defined for the specified channel definition.

tags.name: CharacterizationMagnitudeTag
tags.description: Simple characterization value: magnitude of disturbance (percent: 100%=nominal)

tags.name: CharacterizationFrequencyTag
tags.description: Simple characterization value: frequency (Hertz)

tags.name: ChannelTriggerModuleInfoTag
tags.description: Contains a 32 bit integer that represents module spefic information related to the trigger reason.

tags.name: ChannelTriggerModuleNameTag
tags.description: Contains the name of a device specific code or hardware module, algorithm or rule not necessarily channel based that caused this channel to be recorded

tags.name: CrossTriggerDeviceNameTag
tags.description: Contains the name of the device involved in an external cross trigger scenario.

tags.name: CrossTriggerChannelIndexTag
tags.description: Contains the channel definition index of the channel that triggered in a cross trigger scenrio.

tags.name: ChannelTriggerTypeIDTag
tags.description: Integer ID representing the trigger type for this channel instance. Used only with type ID_QT_VALUELOG wit a trigger method of channel.

tags.name: ChannelFrequencyTag
tags.description: For a channel which contains multiple instances to represent a sparse log of time-stamped frequency-domain information, this specifies the frequency for which this channel instance applies (in Hertz). If not present, the channel characteristics are frequency independent unless further specified by the quantity characteristic.

tags.name: ChannelGroupIDTag
tags.description: For a channel which contains multiple instances to represent a sparse log of time-stamped frequency-domain information, this specifies the frequency for which this channel instance applies (in Index). The index referes to a harmonic or interharmonic group index.

tags.name: OneSeriesInstanceTag
tags.description: One of these collections per series instance.

tags.name: SeriesBaseQuantityTag
tags.description: Contains the nominal base voltage, or any other necessary normalizing quantity.

tags.name: SeriesScaleTag
tags.description: If not present, assumed to be 1. The physical type should match that of tagSeriesValues.

tags.name: SeriesOffsetTag
tags.description: If not present, assumed to be 0. Generally used as a starting point when the ID_SERIES_METHOD_INCREMENT storage method is used. The physical type should match that of tagSeriesValues.

tags.name: SeriesShareChannelIndexTag
tags.description: Identifies the channel which owns the series to be shared. An index into the tagChannelInstances collection.

tags.name: SeriesShareSeriesIndexTag
tags.description: Identifies the series to be shared. An index into the tagSeriesInstances collection. The tagSeriesValues vector from this series is used. This must be present if tagSeriesShareChannelIdx is used.

tags.name: SeriesValuesTag
tags.description: Contains the actual data points of the series. Required unless the data series is shared, in which case both tagSeriesShareChannelIdx and tagSeriesShareSeriesIdx should be present.

RecordLevel.name: RecordLevel
RecordLevel.description: The body of each record is compressed individually. The checksums will be found in the header of each record.

TotalFile.name: TotalFile
TotalFile.description: Everything after the container record is compressed as a single block. This feature has been deprecated under 1.5 and should not be used.

Zlib.name: Zlib
Zlib.description: A standard compression algorithm -- ZLIB -- standardized by the IETF (Internet Engineering Task Force). See http://quest.jpl.nasa.gov/zlib/ for details.

PKZIP.name: PKZIP
PKZIP.description: A commercial package, the PKZIP data compression library, was used to compress the data. This feature has been deprecated under 1.5 and should not be used.

Residual.name: Residual

Net.name: Net
Net.description: Net - the vector or point-on-wave sum of Phases A, B, C and the Neutral phase.  Should be zero in a 4 wire system with no earth return path.

Total.name: Total
Total.description: The value representing a total or other summarizing value in a multi-phase system.

LineToNeutralAverage.name: LineToNeutralAverage

Worst.name: Worst
